tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to a URL in the active browser tab

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element on the page using a ref from snapshot or a CSS selector

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type text into an input element

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page or an element. Supports pixel offsets, scrolling to elements, and named positions (top/bottom). Works with virtual scroll containers used by social media sites.

selector.description: CSS selector of scroll container (for virtual scroll)

toElement.description: Ref or CSS selector to scroll into view

position.description: Scroll to top or bottom of page

tools.name: browser_press_key
tools.description: Press a keyboard key or combination (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown, etc). Supports modifiers like Ctrl+A, Cmd+C.

ref.description: Element ref to focus before pressing

selector.description: CSS selector to focus before pressing

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait for a condition: element to appear, element to disappear, or a fixed delay. Useful for SPAs and dynamic content.

state.description: Wait until element is visible, hidden, or attached to DOM

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Get an accessibility tree snapshot of the page. Returns element refs you can use with click, type, and other tools. Use compact mode (default) for smaller output - only interactive elements.

selector.description: CSS selector to scope the snapshot

compact.description: When true (default), returns only interactive elements with minimal nesting. Set false for full tree.

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the visible page area

tools.name: browser_console
tools.description: Read console messages (log, warn, error) from the browser

tools.name: browser_network
tools.description: Read network requests made by the page. Filter by URL pattern.

filter.description: URL regex pattern to filter requests

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: Manage browser tabs: list, create, close, or focus

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Find elements on the page using natural language (e.g. "login button", "search input"). Returns refs you can use with click/type.

query.description: Natural language description of what to find

tools.name: browser_text
tools.description: Extract raw text content from the page or a specific element

selector.description: CSS selector to scope text extraction

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover over an element to trigger tooltips, dropdown menus, or hover states

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Select an option from a dropdown/select element

selector.description: CSS selector for the select element

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in the page and return the result. Use for DOM queries, reading page state, or any operation not covered by other tools.

expression.description: JavaScript expression or code to evaluate in the page context

tools.name: browser_click_text
tools.description: Click an element by its visible text content. Works on React dropdowns, portals, and overlays that may not appear in snapshots. CSP-safe (no eval). Prefers deepest matching element.

text.description: Text to match against element content (first line)

index.description: Which match to click if multiple (0-based, default 0)

exact.description: Require exact match instead of substring (default false)

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Handle JavaScript dialogs (alert, confirm, prompt). Dialogs block page interaction until handled.

promptText.description: Text to enter for prompt() dialogs

tools.name: browser_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file through a file input element. Uses CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles — works even on strict-CSP pages. Provide the local file path and either a ref from snapshot, a CSS selector targeting the file input, or omit both to auto-find the first input[type="file"].

selector.description: CSS selector for the file input element

filePath.description: Local file path to upload (single file)

files.description: Array of local file paths to upload (multiple files)

tools.name: browser_run_action
tools.description: Run a self-contained JavaScript action object in the page context via CDP. The code must be an expression that evaluates to an object with an execute(params) method. Returns the action result directly. Bypasses CSP restrictions.

code.description: JavaScript expression that evaluates to an action object with an execute(params) function. E.g. ({ name: "my-action", execute: function(p) { return { content: [{ type: "text", text: document.title }] }; } })

actionParams.description: Parameters to pass to the action execute() function

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag from one element or position to another. Uses CDP mouse events for reliable drag-and-drop. Provide either refs/selectors or explicit x,y coordinates.

startRef.description: Ref of the element to drag from

startSelector.description: CSS selector of the element to drag from

endRef.description: Ref of the element to drag to

endSelector.description: CSS selector of the element to drag to

startX.description: Start X coordinate (if not using ref/selector)

startY.description: Start Y coordinate (if not using ref/selector)

endX.description: End X coordinate (if not using ref/selector)

endY.description: End Y coordinate (if not using ref/selector)

steps.description: Number of intermediate mouse move steps

tools.name: browser_fill_form
tools.description: Fill multiple form fields in a single call. Supports text inputs, selects, checkboxes, and contentEditable elements. Reduces round-trips compared to calling browser_type for each field individually. Optionally submit the form after filling.

submit.description: Submit the form after filling all fields
